taxonomy:
# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Value Assignment
*(Games primarily focused on placing or deducing numbers in cells)*
- Ripple Effect
- Sudoku
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 2. Region Division & Area Partitioning
*(Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes)*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing
*(Games where the solver traces a continuous path or closed loop)*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Suraromu
- Pencils

## 4. Cell Shading & Painting
*(Games resolved by determining which cells to shade or leave unshaded)*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Norinori
- LITS
- Usowan
- Kurotto

## 5. Object & Piece Placement
*(Games involving placing specific objects, symbols, or pieces onto the grid)*
- Akari
- Hashiwokakero
- Yosenabe
- Sto-stone
- Chained Block

## 6. Shape & Diagonal Orientation
*(Games centered on geometric shapes, angles, or directional cell orientation)*
- Shakashaka
- Sashigane
- Nurimisaki
- Yajilin

## 7. Movement & Transition Logic
*(Games involving movement rules, migration, or cell state transitions)*
- Satogaeri
- Ripple Effect *(moved — see note)*
- Mid-loop *(moved — see note)*

> **Note:** Each game appears in exactly one category. Borderline games were assigned to the single best-fit category based on their dominant mechanic.

---

*(Revised clean final list — each of the 42 games appears exactly once)*
